applies_to.quote: To All Authorised Dealers in Foreign Exchange Madam / Sir Online submission of Form A2: Removal of limits on amount of remittance

answer.action: Authorised Dealers may now frame internal guidelines with approval from their Board, Board Committee, or Management Committee.
answer.action_quote: Authorised Dealers shall frame appropriate internal guidelines with the approval of their Board or any Board Committee / Management Committee to which powers have been delegated by the Board
answer.amends: A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 12 dated July 03, 2024
